grades.question: An outbreak spreads to a connected city already holding three cubes of that color. Describe timing, outbreak-marker movements, return spread into the first city, and whether different colors share a single three-cube cap.

If a connected city already has 3 cubes of that color, its chain-reaction outbreak happens after the current outbreak resolves. During chain reactions, do not add cubes to cities that already had an outbreak while resolving the current Infection card, so the spread does not return into the first city. Each outbreak advances the marker by 1; the summary does not state that this particular chain reaction necessarily occurs only once, so exact total marker movements depend on further chain reactions.
